lines.zh: 我慢慢走过平原，皮毛像化开的奶油。
lines.en: I cross the plains slowly, coat like melted cream.

lines.zh: 我的蹄声很轻，草叶几乎不动。
lines.en: My hoofbeats are light; the grass barely stirs.

lines.zh: 阳光照在我背上，白得发亮。
lines.en: Sun on my back makes the pale coat shine.

lines.zh: 我走在你旁边，不快也不慢。
lines.en: I walk beside you, neither fast nor slow.

lines.zh: 奶白色的牛，走在绿色的草上。
lines.en: A cream-white cow walking over green grass.

lines.zh: 我走一步，尾巴就摆一下。
lines.en: Each step I take swings my tail once.

lines.zh: 草太密了，我只能慢慢挤过去。
lines.en: The grass is dense, so I push through slowly.

lines.zh: 我跟着母牛，她走哪我走哪。
lines.en: I follow the older cow wherever she goes.

lines.zh: 我这身奶油色，雨一淋就脏。
lines.en: My cream coat stains in the rain.

lines.zh: 腿有点短，走远路会累。
lines.en: My legs are short, so long walks tire me.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方，草又慢慢立起来。
lines.en: Where I step, the grass springs back up.

lines.zh: 我们绕开水塘，泥会弄脏毛。
lines.en: We go around the pond; mud would stain my coat.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，因为背上有阳光。
lines.en: I walk steadily, carrying sunlight on my back.

lines.zh: 前面有片苜蓿，我加快了半步。
lines.en: Clover ahead, so I pick up half a step.

lines.zh: 我沿着篱笆走，找一处矮的缺口。
lines.en: I follow the fence, looking for a low gap.

lines.zh: 晨露打湿了我的蹄子，有点凉。
lines.en: Dew wets my hooves. It is a little cold.

lines.zh: 我站着，风把我的毛吹得软软的。
lines.en: I stand still while the wind softens my coat.

lines.zh: 我身上有一股淡淡的奶味。
lines.en: A faint smell of cream clings to my hide.

lines.zh: 我嚼着草，慢慢咽下去。
lines.en: I chew the grass and swallow it slowly.

lines.zh: 那头牛的颜色比我深多了。
lines.en: That other cow is far darker than I am.

lines.zh: 我用舌头舔了舔前腿。
lines.en: I lick my front leg with a long tongue.

lines.zh: 我眨了眨眼，睫毛也是白的。
lines.en: I blink, and even my lashes are pale.

lines.zh: 云飘过去，草地上暗了一块。
lines.en: A cloud passes and a patch of grass darkens.

lines.zh: 我想躺下来，在暖和的土上。
lines.en: I would like to lie down on warm earth.

lines.zh: 十点生命，我活得很小心。
lines.en: With ten health, I live quite carefully.

lines.zh: 苍蝇落在耳朵上，我甩了甩。
lines.en: A fly lands on my ear, and I shake it off.

lines.zh: 我抬头看天，云很白，像我。
lines.en: I look up; the clouds are pale like me.

lines.zh: 旁边的小牛在叫，声音很细。
lines.en: The calf nearby calls with a thin little voice.

lines.zh: 我呼吸的时候，肚子一起一伏。
lines.en: My belly rises and falls as I breathe.

lines.zh: 草的味道有点甜，我多嚼了两下。
lines.en: The grass tastes sweet, so I chew twice more.

lines.zh: 我慢慢反刍，嘴里有草香。
lines.en: I chew my cud slowly; my mouth tastes of grass.

lines.zh: 牧场的钟响了，我抬头听。
lines.en: The pasture bell rings and I lift my head.

lines.zh: 我嚼着草，忘了咽下去。
lines.en: I chew the grass and forget to swallow.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛浅，虹膜几乎是白的。
lines.en: My eyes are pale, the iris almost white.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我先闻闻你的手背。
lines.en: You reach out, so I sniff your hand first.

lines.zh: 你的衣服颜色很深，我看得清。
lines.en: Your clothes are dark, and I see them clearly.

lines.zh: 我歪头，耳朵朝你的方向转。
lines.en: I tilt my head and point an ear at you.

lines.zh: 你是不是想摸我的毛？
lines.en: Are you hoping to touch my coat?

lines.zh: 我不躲，只是往后退一步。
lines.en: I do not flee; I only take one step back.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我身上，凉凉的。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on me, and it is cool.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，然后低下头。
lines.en: I watched you a long time, then lowered my head.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道让我打了个响鼻。
lines.en: Your smell makes me snort.

lines.zh: 我轻轻哞了一声，算是打招呼。
lines.en: I moo softly, which counts as a greeting.

lines.zh: 别站在阳光里，我会看花眼。
lines.en: Do not stand in the glare; it dazzles me.

lines.zh: 我哞了一声，往牛群那边跑。
lines.en: I moo and run toward the rest of the herd.

lines.zh: 这一下撞在肩上，站不稳。
lines.en: That blow struck my shoulder and I swayed.

lines.zh: 我的毛染红了一小片。
lines.en: A small patch of my coat turned red.

lines.zh: 十点生命，一下就少了一块。
lines.en: Ten health, and a chunk of it is gone.

lines.zh: 你打得很重，我腿都软了。
lines.en: You hit hard, and my legs went weak.

lines.zh: 我退到母牛身后躲着。
lines.en: I retreated behind the older cow to hide.

lines.zh: 伤口在脖子上，低头就疼。
lines.en: The wound is on my neck, so lowering hurts.

lines.zh: 我不是敌人，你为什么打我。
lines.en: I am not your enemy, so why strike me?

lines.zh: 我跌了一下，又爬了起来。
lines.en: I stumbled once and got back up again.

lines.zh: 血落在浅色的毛上，很显眼。
lines.en: Blood shows clearly on such a pale coat.

lines.zh: 你拿着草，我的脚就不听话了。
lines.en: You hold out grass, and my feet disobey me.

lines.zh: 那把小草，我闻到了。
lines.en: That little bunch of grass, I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，鼻子几乎贴着你的手。
lines.en: I follow with my nose almost against your hand.

lines.zh: 走慢点，我肚子有点沉。
lines.en: Slow down; my belly is a little heavy.

lines.zh: 你换个方向，我就跟着转。
lines.en: You change direction, and I turn with you.

lines.zh: 我只会为草走这么远。
lines.en: Only for grass would I walk this far.

lines.zh: 别把草举太高，我够不着。
lines.en: Do not hold the grass too high; I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边舔嘴。
lines.en: I walk along licking my lips.

lines.zh: 你停下，我就把鼻子凑过去。
lines.en: When you stop, I push my nose forward.

lines.zh: 那股味道让我忘了害怕。
lines.en: That smell makes me forget to be afraid.

lines.zh: 我追得不久，就会站在原地。
lines.en: I do not chase long before stopping still.

lines.zh: 你把草丢下，我自己会捡。
lines.en: Drop the grass and I will pick it up myself.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，一直跟到栅栏边。
lines.en: I follow you all the way to the fence.

lines.zh: 这么嫩的草，牧场里没有。
lines.en: Grass this tender does not grow in my pasture.

lines.zh: 你手里的麦子，闻着比草甜。
lines.en: The wheat in your hand smells sweeter than grass.

lines.zh: 隔着栅栏，我也闻得到那味道。
lines.en: Even through the fence I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我的身体很软，撞上来不疼。
lines.en: My body is soft, so bumping me does not hurt.

lines.zh: 你挤过来，我侧着身子让开。
lines.en: You push in, so I turn sideways to let you pass.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩到你鞋上，留个印。
lines.en: My hoof leaves a print on your shoe.

lines.zh: 别踩我的蹄子，那里很敏感。
lines.en: Do not step on my hooves; they are sensitive.

lines.zh: 我身上的奶油味蹭了你一身。
lines.en: The creamy smell of my coat rubs off on you.

lines.zh: 你比我重，我被推得歪了。
lines.en: You are heavier, so I got pushed crooked.

lines.zh: 我挪一步，给你腾点地方。
lines.en: I shift one step to make room for you.

lines.zh: 尾巴被你碰到了，我甩了一下。
lines.en: You touched my tail, and I flicked it.

lines.zh: 我们贴得很近，毛都乱了。
lines.en: We stood so close our coats got mussed.

lines.zh: 你往左，我往右，正好错开。
lines.en: You go left, I go right, and we miss.

lines.zh: 我们这一对，颜色很搭。
lines.en: The two of us make a matching pair.

lines.zh: 我把头靠在她颈边。
lines.en: I rest my head against her neck.

lines.zh: 她比我更白，几乎透明。
lines.en: She is paler than me, almost see-through.

lines.zh: 我们绕着彼此慢慢走。
lines.en: We walk slowly around one another.

lines.zh: 小牛会继承这身浅色。
lines.en: The calf will inherit this pale coat.

lines.zh: 别出声，我们很怕吵。
lines.en: Do not make noise; we dislike commotion.

lines.zh: 我们会在树荫下待一整个下午。
lines.en: We will spend the whole afternoon in shade.

lines.zh: 她的呼吸很轻，像风。
lines.en: Her breathing is light, like a breeze.

lines.zh: 两只浅色的牛站在一起。
lines.en: Two pale cows standing close together.

lines.zh: 这件事，我们做得很安静。
lines.en: We go about this very quietly.

lines.zh: 地上有几根草，我卷起来。
lines.en: A few blades of grass, and I curl them up.

lines.zh: 我这一身奶油色，割草最配。
lines.en: My cream coat goes best with fresh grass.

lines.zh: 那块东西不能吃，我丢开。
lines.en: That thing is not food, so I drop it.

lines.zh: 我用舌尖把它推进嘴里。
lines.en: I use my tongue tip to push it in.

lines.zh: 掉下的花，我也照收。
lines.en: A fallen flower, and I take that as well.

lines.zh: 我捡得很慢，怕踩坏草。
lines.en: I pick things up slowly so as not to crush grass.

lines.zh: 这粒种子太小，看不见。
lines.en: This seed is too small to see.

lines.zh: 我把它含在嘴里，慢慢嚼。
lines.en: I hold it in my mouth and chew slowly.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我推到你脚边。
lines.en: What you dropped, I nudge back to your feet.

lines.zh: 奶油色的毛上沾了草屑。
lines.en: Grass bits on my cream coat.

lines.zh: 我注意到你手里的那把草。
lines.en: I noticed that handful of grass in your hand.

lines.zh: 那边的苜蓿比这边嫩。
lines.en: The clover over there is tenderer than here.

lines.zh: 你走的方向，跟我一样。
lines.en: You are walking the same way I am.

lines.zh: 我闻到水了，就在不远处。
lines.en: I smell water, and it is quite nearby.

lines.zh: 牛群在坡上，我要过去。
lines.en: The herd is on the slope, and I head there.

lines.zh: 有个影子从草丛里闪过。
lines.en: A shadow flickered past in the grass.

lines.zh: 我盯住那块最高的草。
lines.en: I fix on the tallest clump of grass.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我就朝你走。
lines.en: You crouch down, so I walk toward you.

lines.zh: 我看见栅栏门开了。
lines.en: I see that the pasture gate is open.

lines.zh: 目标就是那片阴凉。
lines.en: The target is simply that patch of shade.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，一边嚼草。
lines.en: I stare at you while I chew grass.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，刚好挡住草。
lines.en: You happen to be blocking the grass.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向挪了半步。
lines.en: I shift half a step your way.

lines.zh: 我不确定要不要靠近。
lines.en: I am not sure whether to come closer.

lines.zh: 我慢吞吞地跟在你后头。
lines.en: I trail slowly behind you.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我算一步。
lines.en: You take a step, and I count it.

lines.zh: 我们隔着几步，谁都没动。
lines.en: A few steps apart, neither of us moves.

lines.zh: 奶油色的皮挡不住角。
lines.en: My cream hide won't stop my horns.

lines.zh: 你身后有一片好草。
lines.en: There is good grass just behind you.

lines.zh: 我慢慢绕开你，而不是冲过去。
lines.en: I go around you slowly rather than charging.

lines.zh: 我用头顶你，力气不大。
lines.en: I butt you with my head, and not hard.

lines.zh: 你抓住我的耳朵了，松开。
lines.en: You grabbed my ear, so let go of it.

lines.zh: 我抬起蹄子，轻轻踏了一下。
lines.en: I lift a hoof and give one light stomp.

lines.zh: 别逼我，我也有角。
lines.en: Do not push me; I have horns too.

lines.zh: 这一下只是让你退开。
lines.en: This one is only to make you step back.

lines.zh: 我冲得不快，但很沉。
lines.en: I do not charge fast, but I am heavy.

lines.zh: 你弄疼我了，我才顶的。
lines.en: You hurt me, and that is why I butted.

lines.zh: 我的头很硬，皮很厚。
lines.en: My head is hard and my hide is thick.

lines.zh: 打完以后，我还会站在这里。
lines.en: When it is over, I will still stand here.

lines.zh: 我不想打，但你挡了路。
lines.en: I do not want to fight, but you blocked the way.

lines.zh: 我在平原的清晨出现。
lines.en: I appear on the plains at first light.

lines.zh: 第一口草，是带着露水的。
lines.en: My first mouthful of grass was dewy.

lines.zh: 我的毛很浅，天光照在上面。
lines.en: My coat is pale, and daylight rests on it.

lines.zh: 四周都是草，我不知往哪走。
lines.en: Grass everywhere, and I do not know where to go.

lines.zh: 牛群在我身后叫了一声。
lines.en: The herd called once from behind me.

lines.zh: 我试着站起来，腿有点抖。
lines.en: I tried to stand, and my legs trembled.

lines.zh: 这片草原比我记得的更绿。
lines.en: This meadow is greener than I remember it.

lines.zh: 风先吹到我，然后才是声音。
lines.en: The wind reached me before any sound did.

lines.zh: 我摇摇晃晃走了几步。
lines.en: I took a few wobbling steps forward.

lines.zh: 从刷怪蛋出来，我眨了眨眼。
lines.en: Out of the spawn egg, I blinked a few times.

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我的毛就卷起来了。
lines.en: As the flame nears, my coat curls up.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下来，摔在草里。
lines.en: I slid down the slope and landed in grass.

lines.zh: 奶油色的皮，泡水就沉。
lines.en: Cream-colored hide sinks the moment it soaks.

lines.zh: 爆炸的气浪把我推了很远。
lines.en: The blast wave pushed me a long way back.

lines.zh: 箭扎进腿里，我站得歪了。
lines.en: An arrow sank into my leg and I stand crooked.

lines.zh: 魔法让我的毛一根根立起来。
lines.en: The magic lifted every single hair on my coat.

lines.zh: 草地被啃光了，我越来越轻。
lines.en: The grass is gone and I grow lighter each day.

lines.zh: 雷打在我旁边，我的毛焦了一块。
lines.en: Lightning struck beside me and singed my coat.

lines.zh: 我在往下坠，什么都碰不到。
lines.en: I am falling, and there is nothing to touch.
